title: Atomic Bombing of Hiroshima
description:
The United States dropped an **atomic bomb** on Hiroshima on August 6, 1945, killing an estimated 140,000 people by the end of the year.

This was the first use of nuclear weapons in warfare. Three days later, Nagasaki was also bombed. Japan surrendered on August 15, ending World War II.

The bombings ushered in the nuclear age and the Cold War arms race.
